act.name: Sale of Goods Act, 1930
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing contracts for sale of goods, conditions, warranties, delivery, payment and remedies.

sections.title: Implied conditions as to quality or fitness.
sections.text: Section 16 concerns implied conditions about the quality or fitness of goods; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains when a sale contract carries an implied condition that goods be fit for purpose or of merchantable quality.
